releaseNotes: Lua palette handles now follow per-frame palette keys and restore correctly when a transaction rolls back.
Added scripted palette generation for Octree and RGB5A3, including selected color ranges and nonzero transparent indices.
Added scripted conversion between RGBA, indexed and grayscale artwork with color fitting, grayscale and dithering controls.
Color conversion preserves linked artwork where appropriate, converts tile artwork and safely retires outdated image handles.
Added an AI-agent guide, machine-readable capability statement and llms.txt discovery file with the supported connection paths and limits.
Added a reproducible 63-command example that creates a three-frame ninja-panda idle animation, with commands, editable project and rendered PNG.
The web Scripts panel and desktop Help menu now link directly to the agent guide.
